profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer @ Army Software Factory | Cybersecurity Masters | Active Security Clearance
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at the Army Software Factory, selected in a highly competitive program to build mission-focused software using modern, industry-inspired development practices.

I focus on writing clear, reliable code and contributing to teams that ship, iterate, and improve software based on real user feedback.

I work as a full-stack engineer and apply Extreme Programming (XP) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to build maintainable, high-quality software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Selected in a highly competitive program focused on accelerating and modernizing software delivery through industry-inspired development practices.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Test-Driven Development and +9 skills

company.name: U.S. Army Transformation and Training Command

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Served as a technical project manager responsible for planning, executing, and delivering large, complex technology projects.

Coordinated cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and security to deploy and sustain high-availability systems.

Managed scope, timelines, risk, and stakeholders to ensure reliable delivery in dynamic environments.

Translated user and operational requirements into clear technical objectives and execution plans.
positions.insights: Security Plus, IT Risk Management and +10 skills

positions.title: Troy University Student
positions.description:
Bachelor of Science, Interdisciplinary Studies
Aug 2019 – May 2022
GPA: 3.8 / 4.0 · Magna Cum Laude

Highlights:
	• President, Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc.
        • Troy University 2022 Homecoming King
	• Early leadership experience across student organizations and campus initiatives
positions.insights: Event Planning, Leading Meetings and +6 skills

positions.title: Us Army Cadet
positions.description: As a Cadet, I achieved significant milestones in military leadership and project management. I was honored as a Distinguished Military Graduate and successfully completed the US Army Airborne School. I led multiple Ranger Challenge teams as Captain, effectively managing and coordinating efforts to secure top placements in several brigade-level competitions. These experiences highlight my proficiency in leadership, strategic planning, and team management.

positions.title: Infantry Soldier
positions.description: As a U.S. Infantryman, I honed my skills in tactical operations, leadership, and strategic problem-solving in high-pressure environments. My role required meticulous attention to detail, physical and mental endurance, and the ability to work effectively as part of a team. These experiences provided a strong foundation for my transition into a signal officer role, where I now leverage my background to enhance network security and manage communication systems. The discipline, adaptability, and leadership skills developed as an Infantryman continue to drive my success in my current position as a 25A.
